newsitem.title: USA: Universal Seismic completes Texas projects.
newsitem.headline: Universal Seismic completes Texas projects.

text.p: Universal Seismic Associates Inc said on Tuesday its UNEXCO Inc subsidiary completed its sixth and seventh participation projects, located in Hidalgo County and San Patricio County, Texas.

"UNEXCO has now participated in the acquisition, processing and interpretation of 143 square miles, equivalent to over 91,000 acres, of 3-D seismic programs as working-interest partners," Universal said.
The company said the first well was due to begin by March 15 in the Weslaco Prospect in Hidalgo County, where UNEXCO and Apache Corp each have a 50 percent working interest.
The drilling of the first well in the Sinton Prospect in San Patricio County is expected to begin next month. UNEXCO and Sandalwood Oil and Gas each have a 50 percent working interest.
Universal said UNEXCO entered into five other contracts to acquire 93 square miles of seismic data and expected to drill 10 to 15 wells during the next six months.
